newsitem.title: USA: Mobil accepts bill payments over Internet.
newsitem.headline: Mobil accepts bill payments over Internet.

text.p: Mobil Corp. credit card holders will soon be able to pay their bills over the Internet as well as by mail, the oil company and National Processing Inc. announced Monday.
"It is simple and safe and there is no charge for using it," said Mobil credit card executive Thomas Randolph.
National Processing, which handles mailed bills for Mobil, is using its new Virtual PAY process for Internet-based payments, the Louisville-based company said in a joint statement with Mobil.

Mobil customers who want to pay via the Net will use Mobil's Web site (http://www.mobil.com). Payment information is sent in code in such a way that it cannot be read, received or intercepted by anyone other than National Processing, the companies said.
Security is a major concern in the growing world of Internet commerce.
Mobil credit card holders will learn when they can begin making payments over the Net from their monthly bill.
Mobil already accepts credit card applications via its Web site.
